status: review-input-only; not a completed security gate

sources.title: OWASP Multi Tenant Security
sources.relevance: Treat submitted BU/resource identifiers as selectors and verify authorization against server-owned tenant context; inspect async fan-out and raw batch partitioning.

sources.title: OWASP CSRF Prevention
sources.relevance: Custom AJAX headers depend on constrained CORS. Review mutation authorization and missing-header rejection; compare exact local and HTTPS origin wiring.

sources.title: OWASP Logging
sources.relevance: Exclude tokens, sessions, passwords, database connection strings and encryption keys; validate both request success and parser/upstream failures, while retaining safe diagnostics.

attack_hypotheses: Replay or stale generation after cancel/remove/recreate
Authenticated mixed-owner webhook batch raw payload crossing tenant boundaries
Unauthenticated/CSRF pairing or retired GET invoking provider
Provider echo winning before trusted sender data
Secrets in gateway parser errors or provider callback failure logging
evidence_boundary: REG-SEC and local runtime logs support reproduced observations. Real Meta/device readiness, dependency vulnerability inventory and production rollout are not inferred from these sources.
